name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College & University Students
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education (NSP)
summary: Merit-based national scholarship for the top ~20% of Class XII board performers joining regular UG/PG courses, ran through the National Scholarship Portal.

benefit.details: Paid for up to 5 years of the degree including integrated courses; requires 50%+ marks and 75% attendance for renewal.

special_conditions: Must be above the 80th percentile of the Class XII board — modelled as 80% aggregate
Regular full-time course only; not for distance learning or diploma
No other scholarship may be held concurrently

steps: Register on scholarships.gov.in (fresh registration)
Select 'Central Sector Scheme' under Department of Higher Education
Fill academic and bank details, upload documents
Complete institute and board verification
Monitor NSP dashboard for payment

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students from Minority Communities
summary: Central post-matric scholarship for students of six notified minority communities studying Class XI to PhD with family income within ₹2 lakh.

benefit.details: Maintenance allowance (hosteller/day scholar) plus course fee reimbursement subject to limits.

special_conditions: 30% of scholarships earmarked for girl students
State domicile applies — apply under your home state quota

steps: Register on NSP and choose Ministry of Minority Affairs schemes
Score ≥50% in the last exam: upload marksheet
Provide community and income proofs
Complete institute verification

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (NSP)
summary: Central scholarship for students with 40%+ benchmark disability from Class XI onwards, including maintenance, disability allowance and fee support.

benefit.details: Maintenance allowance + disability allowance + book allowance; hosteller rates higher.

special_conditions: Benchmark disability = 40% or more with valid UDID/disability certificate
50% reservation for girl candidates — unfilled seats transferable

steps: Register on NSP under Department of Empowerment of PwD
Upload UDID and income certificate
Complete institute verification
Track application until DBT

name: Merit Cum Means Scholarship for Professional & Technical Courses (CS)
summary: For minority-community students in professional/technical UG & PG courses (engineering, medicine, management, law, CA etc.) with income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

benefit.details: Course fee reimbursement up to ₹20,000 + maintenance allowance (hosteller/day scholar).

special_conditions: Only professional/technical courses on the approved list (85 listed courses)
Admission through a competitive entrance exam or 50% in qualifying exam

steps: Register on NSP → Ministry of Minority Affairs
Select Merit Cum Means and verify course is on approved list
Upload proofs and complete institute verification
Renew annually with 50%+ marks

name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
summary: Premier-institute scholarship for SC students admitted to notified 'top class' institutions (IITs, NITs, AIIMS, NLUs etc.) — full tuition plus living and device allowances.

benefit.details: Full tuition waived/deposited + ₹86,000 living & other allowances in the first year incl. laptop/books, ~₹41,000 for later years.

special_conditions: Institution must be on the notified Top Class institution list
Income cap revised in recent cycles (₹3.5 lakh) — verify current order
All SC students of the institution within income limit are covered (no slot lottery)

documents: Admission proof in a Top Class institution

steps: Register on NSP → Ministry of Social Justice
Confirm your institution is on the notified list
Upload SC + income proofs and submit
Institute forwards to the Ministry for sanction

name: INSPIRE Scholarship (SHE) — Department of Science & Technology
provider: Department of Science & Technology, Government of India
summary: Flagship science-attraction scholarship for top board performers joining BSc/BS/Integrated MSc in Basic & Natural Sciences — ₹80,000 per year.

benefit.details: ₹5,000/month scholarship plus ₹20,000 annual Mentorship/Summer attachment; up to 5 years including integrated MSc.

special_conditions: Top 1% of Class XII board (cut-off published per board) — modelled as 90%+
Only Basic & Natural Science subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, Statistics, Geology, etc.)
Also open to JEE/NEET top-10,000 and KVPY/NTSE/NTS scholars

documents: Class XII marksheet and board certificate
Admission proof in an eligible science programme

steps: Check the published top-1% cut-off for your board
Register on online-inspire.gov.in when the SHE window opens
Upload marksheet and admission proof
Await provisional offer, then maintain performance for renewal

notes: No income criterion — purely merit/national-rank based.

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship
provider: Maulana Azad Education Foundation, Ministry of Minority Affairs
summary: National scholarship for meritorious girl students of minority communities studying in Class IX–XII.

benefit.details: One-time annual assistance credited via DBT.

special_conditions: Girl students of minority communities only
50%+ marks in the last exam required

steps: Register on the scholarship portal when the cycle opens
Fill personal, school and bank details
Upload proofs and submit
Verify selection status on the portal

notes: Portal/schedule seen to shift between years — re-verify when the cycle opens.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls (Technical Education)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education
summary: ₹50,000/year for girl students admitted to AICTE-approved UG degree or diploma programmes via centralised admission.

benefit.details: Lump-sum annual amount for fees, books, equipment and contingencies; duration of the programme.

special_conditions: Admission to an AICTE-approved technical programme in the first year (or lateral entry)
Maximum two girl children per family
Merit of the qualifying admission exam decides selection — 10,000 seats/year

steps: Register on NSP → AICTE schemes
Select Pragati and enter institute AISHE details
Upload admission + income proofs
Institute verifies; renewal each year on promotion

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship (Students with Disability, Technical Education)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education
summary: ₹50,000/year for students with 40%+ disability admitted to AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma programmes.

benefit.details: Lump sum towards academic expenses for the programme duration.

special_conditions: Disability of 40%+ certified as per RPwD Act
First-year (or lateral entry) admission in AICTE-approved course required

steps: Register on NSP → AICTE → Saksham
Upload disability and admission proofs
Complete institute verification
Renew annually on successful promotion

name: PG Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
summary: Supports the family's only girl child through her postgraduate degree — ₹36,200 per year for the duration of a full-time regular PG course.

benefit.details: Paid via DBT for two years for a full-time regular PG programme.

special_conditions: Must be the only girl child (no brother, or twin/fraternal sisters)
Age below 30 years at PG admission
Regular full-time PG course in a recognised institution

documents: Affidavit of single girl child status

steps: Register on NSP under UGC schemes
Select PG Indira Gandhi scholarship
Upload affidavit and PG admission proof
Institute verifies; continue for the PG duration

name: PG Merit Scholarship for University Rank Holders
summary: Rewards first and second rank holders at UG level who join a PG programme — ₹3,100 per month for the PG duration.

benefit.details: For the duration of the PG course, subject to performance.

special_conditions: Must be a 1st/2nd university rank holder at UG level (manual verification)
At least 60% in graduation
Full-time regular PG in a recognised university

steps: Register on NSP under UGC schemes
Upload rank certificate and admission proof
Institute verification then UGC sanction

notes: Rank-holder condition can't be machine-verified — flagged as an assumption during matching.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
provider: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
summary: Arrests school drop-out after Class VIII: ₹12,000/year for talented students from low-income families from Class IX to XII.

benefit.details: For Classes IX–XII in government/government-aided/local-body schools; state NMMS exam selects awardees.

special_conditions: Selection through the State NMMS examination (MAT + SAT) in Class VIII
Continuation in Class IX–XII requires qualifying the NMMS exam
55%+ in Class VII (50% for reserved categories) — modelled as 55%

steps: Apply for the state NMMS exam via SCERT in Class VIII
Clear MAT & SAT cut-offs fixed by the state
Open the NSP application within the national window
Get school + district verification for disbursement

notes: Exam-based — the match assumes NMMS selection; confirm your state exam date.
